plan: Read the official exam guide first - domains, weightings and the 12 sample questions tell you what is actually tested.
Sit Claude Code Foundations here and look at the domain breakdown on your results, not just the score.
Study only your weakest two domains using the resources below. Skip what you already score well on.
Sit Scenario Practice - these are the trap questions where most candidates lose marks.
Sit the Full Mock Exam twice. Once you clear 720 consistently, book the real exam.
